reviewGuide.Why selected: Stable DOI and compact data paper provide an accessible UAV example with concrete label-overlay verification.
reviewGuide.First manual action: Open paper Figures 2–3 and XML example; verify six class codes, 2,440 images and one image-label overlay.
reviewGuide.Known limitation: Images include crops and augmentation. Random splits do not establish original-frame independence; route groups remain unverified.
